newsitem.title: GERMANY: German state Bavaria Feb CPI up 0.4 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: German state Bavaria Feb CPI up 0.4 pct mth/mth.

text.p: The German state of Bavaria said on Tuesday that consumer prices in February rose 0.4 percent from January and 1.6 percent from February 1996.
The state was the third of four German states to report consumer price data which is used to compute provisional west German inflation.
In January, Bavarian CPI climbed 0.3 percent month-on-month and 1.6 percent from a year earlier.
Earlier the state of Baden-Wuerttemberg said that consumer prices for February rose 0.4 percent month-on-month and rose 1.7 percent year-on-year.
The state of Hesse had also said that consumer prices there rose 0.3 percent month-on-month and were up 1.5 percent year-on-year.
